title: GTA 6 Learned All the Right Lessons From Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Gaming outlet Polygon reports that GTA 6 successfully nails a crucial design element from 2017's The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 and the Influence of Breath of the Wild

As anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to reach unprecedented heights, gaming media and fans are dissecting every piece of analysis regarding Rockstar Games' upcoming title. According to a recent report by Polygon, GTA 6 successfully nails one specific element that The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild got right back in 2017: the perfect introduction.

Back in 2017, Nintendo's masterpiece redefined open-world design, largely thanks to its brilliant opening hours on the Great Plateau, which taught players the core mechanics organically without relying on tedious text tutorials. Polygon points out that GTA 6 has captured this exact philosophy, mastering the art of how a massive open-world experience should introduce itself to the player.

## Evolution of Open-World Design

Rockstar Games has always been renowned for cinematic storytelling and sprawling virtual worlds. However, designing an introductory sequence that balances narrative setup with player freedom is notoriously difficult. Breath of the Wild set a gold standard for the industry by letting players learn through active exploration.

While the Polygon report does not detail every specific gameplay mechanic of GTA 6's opening, this insight suggests that the developers have focused on delivering a seamless onboarding process. Industry observers note that this approach could mean fewer rigid, mandatory tutorials, allowing players to dive straight into the atmosphere of the game's setting naturally.

## Editor's Take

Borrowing design philosophy from one of the greatest open-world games of the modern era is a bold yet promising move for Rockstar. If GTA 6 truly mirrors the brilliant introduction style of Breath of the Wild, players are in for a remarkably smooth and engaging entry into its vast world from the very first minute.
